findings.claim: the wave moved the gates' decision law into docs/gates/*.json, which isCodePath classifies as non-code: the actor the gates police can rewrite any threshold, exemption list, accepted-finding row, required transport, or the ratchet baseline in a commit the commit-msg gate, push fence, and doctor all ignore — every guard green with the ratchet defanged. The repo already treats this exact class as a defect: .githooks/.github/.stallion-base were reclassified as code because the gated party must not rewrite the fence in the push it fences
findings.proof: edit docs/gates/complexity.json threshold 8->12 and commit: no task footer demanded (isCodePath false), fence filters the path out, doctor family check passes (JSON parses), gate-registry passes (invocation text unchanged), complexity-gate self-test passes (judge compares against the same live threshold). Identical one-edit shapes: coverage.json exempt rows, reader-existence accepted rows, gate-registry transport drops, debt-register baseline reset

findings.claim: remote-string-lint honors a self-authored in-file exemption marker (lint-allow-local-expansion): the policed file supplies both the value and the permission. Deliberate upstream design (marked, not guessed); corpus currently empty so exposure is latent
findings.justification: Deliberate upstream design, kept: the marker is 'marked, not guessed' — an in-file lint-allow-local-expansion marker that suppresses local-expansion checking on its own line. The alternative (no marker) makes the lint refuse constructs that are occasionally legitimate in remote dispatch (computed host names), and a marker logged in the diff is auditable where a guessed allowlist is not. Exposure is latent (the corpus config ships with an empty walk; vendors who populate deploy/ accept the marker discipline with it). The config that widens the corpus is now fence surface, so shipping the marker regime itself cannot ride unfenced.

findings.claim: complexity-gate --update-baseline bulk re-stamps every ceiling at current values with no justification or hash binding — the rise-forgiveness path is unaudited, in contrast to doc-reconcile's deliberate no-bulk-restamp law
findings.justification: Kept upstream's deliberate asymmetry: --update-baseline exists because the stale-baseline law (row gone or fallen under threshold = dead gate) demands a bulk refresh path, and requiring a per-row justification on regeneration would make the register grow noise — the known hole the upstream header already states ((1) is the birth check, (2) is the ratchet; only baseline-time functions are ratcheted). The rise-forgiveness risk is now double-bound: the baseline file is fence surface (footer + declared scope required to touch it), and every regeneration is a reviewable diff of exactly which ceilings moved.
